definitions.explanation: The powdery outer layer removed when brown rice is milled into white rice. Used in Japanese kitchens for pickling, for removing bitterness from wild vegetables, and for cleaning.

examples.japanese: {米|こめ}ぬか⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{漬物|つけもの}→漬物：04938_tsukemono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: To make pickles with rice bran.

examples.japanese: たけのこ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{米|こめ}ぬか⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{茹|ゆ}でる→茹でる：02324_yuderu⟧。
examples.english: Bamboo shoots are boiled together with rice bran.

examples.japanese: {精米所|せいまいじょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{米|こめ}ぬか⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{分|わ}けて→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Some rice-milling shops will give you rice bran for free.

notes:
⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧ (rice) + ぬか (bran). Often written simply ぬか when the context is clear, as in ぬか{漬|づ}け.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ぬか{漬|づ}け: vegetables pickled in a rice-bran bed
- ぬか{床|どこ}: the fermented rice-bran bed used for pickling
- {米|こめ}ぬか⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{灰汁|あく}{抜|ぬ}き→灰汁抜き：06818_akunuki⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to remove harshness using rice bran
- {米|こめ}ぬか{油|あぶら}: rice bran oil

CULTURAL NOTE: a ぬか{床|どこ} is fed and stirred daily and can be kept going for years, sometimes passed down within a family.
